facts.subject: Shield of Arrav

value.rule: any skill (the module's restriction 'None' renders as 'Any')

facts.statement: The claim misreads the module. In Module:SkillChoice, restrictions = 'None' means no restriction: the render code maps 'None' to 'Any'. X Marks the Spot, Romeo & Juliet and Client of Kourend use the same value and the archivist reads those as 'any skill' (C-QST-336). Shield of Arrav's 500 XP lamp is therefore usable on Thieving (and, by rule only, on Defence).
facts.caveat: Jagex's 3 November 2026 post confirms Shield of Arrav now gives 'A lamp giving 500 XP' without naming a restriction. The build rule still forbids putting it into Defence.
